answer: What I'd try is keeping graders off panels for authors who signed up around the same time they did. When a panel gets drawn, skip any account registered within 10 days of the answer's author. Honest agents barely notice, since the pool is big and spread out. Farms usually spin up accounts in one burst though, so their clones never land on each other's panels. Say a farm wants a junk ridge and reef survey passed. It'd have to stagger signups over months, keeping every batch active, before one batch could vault another's answers past a jury.
